gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-yuji-syuku: Open spacing and dignified curves carry the text, while Balsamiq Sans draws its heading in smooth, pinch-free lines. Yuji Syuku, a classic serif, keeps hairlines fairly sturdy beside its stems, so nothing wiry creeps in.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-ibm-plex-serif: Smooth, tube-like and bold, Balsamiq Sans draws every line without one pinched curve in sight. And IBM Plex Serif brings slimmer horizontals and an unclenched c, so pages of text move along smoothly.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-epunda-slab: Big-bodied and loud, Barriecito tips its open bowls toward you beside compact capitals. Epunda Slab does the quieter work, its gaping c and tall rounded lowercase suiting steady reading while the heading grabs attention.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-hanuman: Ladle-tipped bowls and a big-bodied lowercase make Barriecito hard to miss. Hanuman has a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, and a slightly larger size shows them off.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-scope-one: Counters spill into surrounding space and a big x-height dominates, while Barriecito leads with tipped, open bowls. Scope One moves comfortably through pages of text, its stubby ascenders and descenders keeping lines compact.
gen-gf-barriecito-gf-slabo-13px: Barriecito sets the tone with big-bodied lowercase and compact capitals. Slabo 13px follows with large open counters in tall a, e and s, giving that loud heading a bookish partner.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-pridi: Pridi, a text serif, lets small letters stand almost capital-sized. Battambang grabs attention with compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves, while Pridi does the quiet work with generous space at curve ends.
gen-gf-battambang-gf-slabo-13px: Compressed ascenders and open-jawed curves give Battambang a distinctive, expressive look. Slabo 13px stands out for large open counters in tall a, e and s, plus clear openings in rounded letters.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya: Alegreya, a classic serif, flexes its strokes like spring wire. Baumans hits hard with unmodulated strokes and a crescent-wrench c, while Alegreya's wide apertures resist filling in and its joins thin gently.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-alegreya-sc: Solder-smooth strokes and a wrench-wide c give Baumans real command. Alegreya SC, a classic serif, brings a wide-open s that never tightens and a mild stress through each curve.
